build_now: Choose the smallest useful set of features from the user's scope that delivers the fastest aha moment through a complete core workflow, honoring explicit user priorities.

primary_actors.goal: Record daily driver rent payments quickly with UTR and payment screenshot, track submission status on a calendar, and fix rejected submissions.
pain_points: Manual tracking across WhatsApp receipts creates reconciliation disputes with drivers.
Missing date mapping where drivers pay lump sums for 3 days or partial payments for 1 day.
Lack of visibility into why accounts rejected a receipt.

primary_actors.goal: Audit submitted bank/UPI receipts side-by-side with bank statement UTRs, approve verified collections, or reject duplicates/fakes with clear operational remarks.
pain_points: Switching back and forth between browser tabs and image viewers breaks focus.
Duplicate UTR entry by drivers or staff.
Delayed notifications to ground staff leading to vehicle key release on unverified slips.

primary_actors.goal: Oversee rent collection health (expected vs verified vs outstanding), manage driver daily rent contracts, audit staff performance, and export clean accounting reports.
pain_points: Cluttered dashboards with unnecessary charts and accounting jargon.
Inability to audit who modified or verified a transaction.

user_persona.access_model: Simple role switcher (Staff, Accounts, Admin) in the top bar without mandatory login redirects, fulfilling explicit user preference.

regional_conventions.reference_code: UTR (Unique Transaction Reference, 12 digits for UPI / 16-22 chars for IMPS/NEFT)

workflow_architecture.primary_workflow: Calendar-Based Payment Intake & Accounts Audit Gate

workflow_stages.trigger: Driver arrives at fleet hub or sends daily UPI screenshot.
workflow_stages.action: Search driver by Name, Mobile (10-digit), Vehicle Plate (e.g. DL 1Z B 3901), or Driver ID (R39-DRV-1024). Autocomplete populates live driver info card.
workflow_stages.outcome: Driver card displays active vehicle, city, joining date, agreed daily rent (e.g. ₹900/day), status badge (Active/Suspended/On Leave), and Month-to-Date Rent Summary.

workflow_stages.action: Inspect month grid with large clickable date cells. Visual state immediately shows paid, pending, partial, and rejected days.
guardrails: Dates prior to driver's rent start date are disabled with muted pattern and tooltip 'Prior to joining date'.
Future dates are disabled by default with toggle 'Allow Advance Rent' for verified advance bookings.
Today's date is subtly highlighted with a Route39 green halo border.

workflow_stages.trigger: Clicking an unpaid (White/Grey), partial (Blue), or rejected (Red) date cell.
workflow_stages.action: Modal opens with auto-populated Driver Name, Vehicle, Selected Date, and Default Daily Rent. Staff inputs Paid Amount (₹), Payment Mode (UPI / Bank Transfer / Cash), 12-digit UTR number (auto-validated against duplicates), optional remarks, and uploads payment screenshot.
workflow_stages.preview_and_feedback: Inline drag-and-drop receipt preview with thumbnail and replace action. Validation flags invalid UTR format or duplicate UTR previously submitted in the database.
workflow_stages.outcome: Cell transitions to Orange 'Pending Verification'. Real-time notification badge pushed to Accounts Verification queue.

workflow_stages.trigger: New pending submissions appear in verification dashboard summary counter.
workflow_stages.action: Open Accounts Verification tab. Table shows filterable list by city, vehicle, staff, and date. Clicking any row opens split-pane audit drawer.
workflow_stages.inspection_and_decision: Left pane features high-res screenshot viewer with pan, zoom (100% to 300%), rotate, and fullscreen/download. Right pane displays driver details, entered amount vs daily rent, bank UTR, staff remarks, and previous payment history.

outcome_branching.approve: Clicking green 'APPROVE PAYMENT' displays single-step confirmation with total credited amount. On confirm, status becomes Green 'Verified', audit log records verifier timestamp, and driver's outstanding balance recalculates.
outcome_branching.reject: Clicking red 'REJECT PAYMENT' forces mandatory rejection category (Invalid UTR / Amount Mismatch / Blurry Screenshot / Duplicate Entry) and specific operational remarks. System flags date Red 'Rejected' and pushes immediate in-app alert to staff.

workflow_stages.trigger: In-app bell notification: 'Payment rejected for Driver Rajesh Kumar (18 Oct 2026): UTR not matching statement'.
workflow_stages.action: Staff clicks notification to jump directly to driver calendar on 18 Oct. Clicking the Red cell shows rejection reason, previous slip, and option to 'Upload Corrected Receipt' or 'Re-submit with Corrected UTR'.
workflow_stages.outcome: Submits updated record back into pending queue with 'Re-submitted' audit tag.

navigation_structure.type: Vertical Sidebar on Desktop, Collapsible Bottom Sheet / Mobile Drawer on Small Viewports

tradeoff_analysis.chosen: Vertical left sidebar (60px collapsed icons / 240px expanded).
tradeoff_analysis.reason_for_choice: With 6 distinct destinations (Rent Calendar, Accounts Verification, Payment History, Reports, Driver Management, Staff Management) plus role indicators and notifications, a top bar quickly overcrowds on laptops and conflicts with secondary filters. The vertical sidebar protects vertical scanning space for calendar date cells and dense audit tables, and permits quick role switching without obscuring working data.

elements: Route39 Logo with subtle 'Fleet Rent' moniker
In-app Notification Bell (shows rejection alerts and pending approvals with unread dot)

visual_direction_choice.rationale: Internal fleet operations teams in fast-paced hub environments demand high legibility under varying lighting conditions, neutral surfaces to prevent eye strain during 8-hour data reconciliation, and crisp semantic status signals. Direction A pairs an ultra-clean white canvas with warm charcoal typography and vibrant Route39 green accents, strictly avoiding decorative noise or accounting jargon.
visual_direction_choice.alternative_considered: Direction B: Dense Dark Ops Console
visual_direction_choice.rejection_reason: Dark mode consoles reduce legibility when reading scanned paper receipts and mobile screenshots with white backgrounds, causing glare and eye fatigue during photo auditing.

typography.font_family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
typography.font_family_monospace: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'SFMono-Regular', Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace
typography.font_selection_reason: IBM Plex Sans delivers a sober, humanist, slightly narrow industrial character designed for high-density logistics and financial ERPs. It features rock-solid tabular figures (tnum) essential for Indian rupee amounts, dates, and vehicle numbers.

spacing_and_density.table_density: Compact (36px row height, 8px vertical padding, 12px horizontal padding) for scanning large batches of transactions without excessive scrolling.
spacing_and_density.calendar_density: Generous touch targets (108px x 108px min cell area on desktop) to enable error-free clicking during high-volume data entry.

recommended_component_architecture: DriverAutocomplete: Search input with dropdown portal, keyboard navigation (up/down/enter), and debounce (150ms).
MonthlyCalendar: Clean grid computation with day-of-week headers, previous/next month filler cells, and status styling hooks.
PaymentModal: Accessible dialog with focus trap, Esc to close, and form state reset on exit.
ScreenshotViewer: Zoom/pan container utilizing CSS transform scale and translate, rotate 90deg, and image fit toggle.
RoleSwitcher: Dropdown in header setting React state or localStorage key 'route39_active_role'.
